scope: offline LIGHT reserve / next-round-money diagnostic; no production policy input or modification

inputs.corpus_contract: frozen IEM Cologne Major 2026 player-round table and replay pre-state packages
inputs.main_scenario: LOSS_NO_PLANT; N = current money - actual spend + current loss reward

requested_light_fields.note: row-level values are deterministically recomputed from the frozen corpus; artifact stays aggregate-only

overall.hypothesis_pattern: reserve-target compensation predicts a negative reward-vs-residual association and a weaker reward-vs-next-cash association

definitions.strict_full_rifle_plus_armor: next actual mode FULL and resulting rifle with armor
definitions.full_buy_like: next actual mode FULL and resulting rifle or sniper with armor

definition.retained_primary_top_up: retained primary exists, regardless of resulting family
definition.no_primary_pistol_utility_or_armor: no retained primary and no resulting primary; secondary/utility/armor may change
definition.new_smg_plus_armor: no retained primary; resulting SMG with armor
definition.other_new_primary_bundle: no retained primary; any other resulting primary bundle

force_armor_invariant_audit.invariant: FORCE => armor > 0 except explicit AWP-no-armor path

hypothesis_assessment.decision: Do not replace LIGHT with a single reserveTarget formula from this corpus. Keep future affordability as explicit trajectory context; separately revisit the fixed SMG-plus-armor bundle and enforce the FORCE armor invariant in a later implementation round.
primary_reasons: LOSS_NO_PLANT next cash is less concentrated than residual cash overall and on both sides.
Residual medians do not fall by approximately $500 when loss reward rises by $500; next-cash medians instead move materially with reward tier.
LIGHT has materially different POST_PISTOL, no-primary, new-SMG, other-primary, and retained-primary structures rather than one stable target.
qualifying_observations: Retained-primary and retained-armor aggregates share a $4700 next-cash median with their non-retained counterparts.
Among conservatively linked LIGHT losses, 87.96% are actual FULL next round and 83.84% are strict FULL rifle-plus-armor states; this is observational and does not establish the reserve mechanism.
